rules.name: App Repackaging Detection
rules.description: Android and iOS specific attack detection: app repackaging, certificate pinning bypass, API tampering
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "app" or CommandLine contains "repackaging" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MOBILE_SECURITY-097
